content.short: Hypernative is a proactive security and risk prevention platform for web3/crypto.
content.description: Hypernative provides proactive security by continuously detecting and preventing threats in real time and before they impact, including zero‑day hacks and anomalies, across both your own infrastructure and third‑party components such as bridges and oracles. It also detects and monitors economic and governance risks tied to your project or positions, enabling informed oversight and risk‑aware decision making. Operational monitoring is enhanced with machine‑learning models that identify unusual activity among participants, projects, and cross‑chain events, supporting fast responses and safer growth.
